name: MiniMax-M2-REAP-172B-A10B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 204800). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA, all-full attention (attn_type_list all 1; M2 line abandoned M1's hybrid lightning attention)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A one-shot expert-pruned compression of MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2, not a new base model and not a quant: uniform REAP pruning removed 25% of experts, 256 -> 192 per layer, taking the model from 229B to 172.5B total (10B active, 8 of 192 routed). Config differs from the base's only in num_local_experts. Recorded because the card prints a base column and a this-model column in one table, and it wins 3 of 8 rows - AIME25 +6.6, MBPP+ +1.9, MBPP +0.5 - while losing HumanEval+ (-2.4), MATH-500 (-2.2) and the agentic rows. A memory/quality trade-off with a genuine reasoning gain, not an across-the-board improvement. Sibling of the 139B/162B REAP variants already in the catalog. Licence 'other' (modified MIT), repo created 2025-11-15. CARD-TABLE COMPLETION 2026-11-01: five of eight eval columns added from the same HTML table (HumanEval 93.9, HumanEval+ 86.6, MATH-500 89.4, tau2-Bench Telecom 57.6, BFCLv3 61.5). The record previously held only the three columns where this 25%-pruned model beats the base, which read as a clean win; it actually loses HumanEval+, MATH-500, tau2 and BFCLv3 too.
